item.title: mnemo-jvm-warden
item.description: Kubernetes controller and sidecar that resize JVM pod memory on a schedule with in-place resize, releasing heap before shrinking the pod.

item.title: k8s-namespace-sync
item.description: Kubernetes operator that copies Secrets and ConfigMaps from a source namespace to other namespaces and keeps them in sync, including namespaces created later, with glob filters on resource names.
